text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: As {0} was walking through the busy streets of Landosol, a small, familiar shadow came into his field of vision.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ランドソルの繁華街を歩いていた{0}の視界に
見覚えのある小柄な影が立ち止まる。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ah. Ahaha... What a coincidence. ...Out for another walk, huh? I see... Got too much time on your hands, don't you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ。
あはは……
偶然だねえ。
……
まさか、
また散歩の途中？
そっかー、
ヒマを持て余してんだねえ……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Well. I guess this is what they call "fate". If you're not busy, wanna tag along for a bit? I need to do some shopping.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
これも
縁
ってやつかな。
ヒマなら
ちょっと付き合ってくんない？
買い物。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Honestly, I was planning on going alone, but... Ah, I've already decided what I'm going to buy. It's a gift.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ホントは一人で行こうと思ってたんだけどね～
ああ、
買うものは決まってるんだ。
お祝いの品。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Didn't I mention it before? An old friend from my hometown sent me a letter saying she got married. Now I've got an invitation to her wedding reception.
text_block_list.orig_text:
前話さなかったっけ？
「結婚しました♪」
って
手紙送ってきた
地元の友人。
それが
今度披露宴する
って招待状きちゃってね。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Obviously, I can't really participate while I'm still in this body. So I thought I’d at least send a nice gift.
text_block_list.orig_text:
つっても
この体じゃいけないから、
せめてよさげな祝いの品でもおくろうかな
って。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: That's right, you... I remember hearing you do a lot of part-time delivery work. Could you deliver it for me? Also, I'd like you to give them a message on my behalf.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そだ。
君、
確か
配達のバイトも結構やってたって
言ってたよね。
配達
頼める？
あと
ついでに代理でメッセージも。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: No, even if I went like this, they wouldn't recognize me. And if I used that body-swapping elixir, the effects would wear off in a matter of minutes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
この体でいっても、
向こうも分かんないから。
入れ替わりの秘薬だって
数十分で元に戻っちゃうからさ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Hm? A substitute...? You mean I'd be my own proxy? I'd deliver the message myself... as my own niece? ...I see, that could work...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
代理
って……
私が
私の代理？
私がメッセージ伝えるの？　
姪っ子として？
……
なるほど、
それなら
ありか……？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: That's {0}-kun for you. Young people really do think outside the box.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さすが{0}くん。
若者は発想が柔軟だね。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ah... still, that won't work. The reception hall is near my hometown. It's not the kind of place a child can go to alone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
でも無理だわ。
披露宴会場、
うちの故郷の近くだから。
子どもの体一人でいけるようなとこじゃないの。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Huh...? "Didn't you just hire me for some part-time delivery work"...? Hehe... You really are something else.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……
配達のバイト
頼まれたでしょ
って……？
ふふ……
まったく君って人は。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Alright, then let's have a go at this together. ...Actually, I feel like I've been relying on you a lot lately...
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かった、
じゃあ
一緒にお願いします。
……
ってか
最近君に
頼ってばっかだな……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: On the day of the reception, Sono and {0} arrived at the garden wedding venue.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そして、披露宴当日。
ソノと{0}は会場となる
ガーデンウェディングの会場へ来ていた。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Haha, they really splurged to have a reception in such a nice place. ...It's been almost a year since I left my hometown, huh? I wonder how that girl's doing~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
こんないいとこで披露宴なんて
奮発したじゃん。
……
故郷出てからだから
１年近く会ってないのか。
元気かな
あの子──

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, there she is. Hehe... She looks so happy. Alright, let's go.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ、
いた。
ふふ……
幸せそうな顔しちゃってさ。
じゃ、
いこっか。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Hello...! Congratulations on your marriage...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんにちは……！
ご結婚おめでとうございます……！

text_block_list.name: Bride
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much♪ ...Huh? And you are...? Whose daughter might you be?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうもありがとう♪
……あれ、
あなたは？
どなたの娘さんかしら？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ah, I... I'm acting on behalf of Aunt Sono. My name is Iroha, and I am her niece.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
私……
ソノおばちゃんの代理です。
私はソノおばちゃんの姪で
イロハって言います。

text_block_list.name: Bride
text_block_list.text: Huh? Sono's? Her niece, huh... I can kind of see the resemblance. She said she was too busy to attend, but she's so conscientious. Maybe it's because she opened up a shop?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
ソノの？　
姪っ子ちゃんかあ。
確かに面影あるかも。
本人は忙しくて不参加って言ってたのに、
律儀だなー
忙しいのって、
新しくお店を始めたからだっけ？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right. Ah, this is a beauty serum from her shop. Please follow the instructions and the dosage written here when using it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
そうです。
あ、
これ
そのお店の商品の
美容液です。
こちらに書かれた
用法用量を守って使ってください。

text_block_list.name: Bride
text_block_list.text: Oh...! That looks like it'll be quite effective. Thanks! Now my dear'll get to see me shining even brighter.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おー、
なんかすごく効果ありそう。
ありがとね、
これで彼にもっと輝いてるあたしを見てもらえるわ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Heheh... To think someone who was more into food than romance like you would end up getting married...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ……
色気よりも食い気だったあんたがまさか
結婚なんてねぇ……

text_block_list.name: Bride
text_block_list.text: Eh?
text_block_list.orig_text: え？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Crap... That's what Aunt Sono said. Right, Onii-chan?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やば。
……
って
ソノおばちゃんが言ってました。
ね、
お兄ちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Bride
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Yeah, that sounds like something she'd say. You brought her here, huh? Thanks. Are you... Oh, looks like it's almost time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
まあ確かに言いそう。
君が連れてきてくれたんだ。
ありがとうね。
もしかして君って……
あ、
そろそろ時間みたい。

text_block_list.name: Bride
text_block_list.text: We've prepared some delicious food today, so make sure you and her niece enjoy yourselves. Let's catch up again later.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日は、
料理もおいしいの用意してるからさ、
君も姪っ子ちゃんも
楽しんでいってよ。
また後でお話ししよ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, we were able to deliver my gift and message without her finding out. Now then, it'd be a waste to head back now... let's take her up on that offer and enjoy ourselves.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふふ、
バレずにお祝いできたよ。
さて、
このまま帰るのもなんだし、
ここはお言葉に甘えて
楽しんでいこっか。

text_block_list.name: Waiter
text_block_list.text: Dear guest, if you're looking for food, please come this way. Here. For the young lady, we have a kid's mini curry and gratin.
text_block_list.orig_text:
招待客の方は
こちらへどうぞ。
はい、
お嬢ちゃんには
お子様用のミニカレーに
グラタンもあるよ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: That looks delicious. ...Oh, there's caviar over there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
美味しそうですね。
……あ、
向こうにキャビアがあるわよ！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ehh, zucca's chilled potage and squid gratin alle erbe. And the main dish is beef bollito nel vino. Hey, Chef. Can I get everything from over here? ( TLNote: italian dishes )
text_block_list.orig_text:
へー、
ズッカの冷製ポタージュに
イカのグラティナーティアッレエルベ。
メインは牛のボリートネルヴィーノじゃん。
へいシェフ。
ここのやつ
全部くださる？

text_block_list.name: Waiter
text_block_list.text: S-Sure. You sure know your food, even though you're a child. These are some of our finest dishes, so please enjoy them to your heart's content.
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
はい。
や……
お子さまなのに
詳しいですね。
こっちも
自慢の料理ですから、
心行くまで
ご堪能下さい。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Oh, I sure will... plenty. We've come all this way to be at this reception, so I’m definitely getting my fill.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そりゃもう、
たっぷり。
披露宴まできたんだから、
元とるわよ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: After enjoying the food for a while, Sono paused and watched the reception unfold in its bright, celebratory atmosphere.
text_block_list.orig_text:
しばらく料理を堪能したソノは、
手を止めて
華やいだ雰囲気で進む披露宴を見ていた。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that girl... Guess it's what they call "fine feathers make a fine bird", huh? She's beautiful. The most beautiful in the world.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
あいつ……
馬子にも衣装
ってやつ？
きれいじゃん。
世界一、
きれい。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: No, I'm not so far gone that I'd get depressed at my friend's wedding. It does feel like we've drifted apart, though... It's a little lonely.
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
友達の結婚式で
テンション下がるほど終わってないから。
遠くに行っちゃった気がして
ちょっと寂しいけどさ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: That girl and I... We've known each other since we were little. She was always the kind of girl who lived on the spur of the moment, but now she looks all grown up... Then again, I guess it makes sense... she's 26 already.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの子とは
小っちゃい頃からの幼なじみでさ。
ノリだけで生きてる様な子だったのに、
すっかり大人の顔しちゃって……
って、
26だから当たり前か。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah. ...Ahaha, you're really piling up the mini curry. And why are you giving me that smile now?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
ね。
……あはは、
ミニカレー大盛りにしてんじゃん。
それで何でそんな笑顔なのよ……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Thump...!
text_block_list.orig_text: ドキン……ッ！

text_block_list.name: ソノ
text_block_list.text:
え、
なに。
なんか
急に胸に
ズンときたんだけど……
ちょ、
まって…………？　
今のもしかして心臓！？
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
なに。
なんか
急に胸に
ズンときたんだけど……
ちょ、
まって…………？　
今のもしかして心臓！？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Wha... No way, I cannot allow this. I can't get sick while I'm in Iroha's body. I have to go to the hospital...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ……
絶対ダメなんだけど。
イロハの体で病気なんて。
病院行かないと……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: No good, it's getting stronger and stronger... No, wait. This is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だめだ、
どんどん大きくなる……
いや、
待って。
これ……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: This... it's the sound of my heart. And the reason it's pounding...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これ、
心臓の音だ。
そんで、
ドキドキしてる理由は……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Is because I'm together with this boy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この人と、
一緒にいるからだ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: No, gross, gross, gross! What the hell am I even thinking...?! He's 17! A kid! I can't believe my heart is racing like this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや
キモイキモイキモイキモイ、
何言ってんだ私……！？
相手17歳の子どもだよ！？　
そんな、
ドキドキだなんて……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Ah, yeah...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ！？
あ、
うん……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: No back pain, and I wake up feeling refreshed. I always thought being in a kid's body was the best. The shop's doing well, the guild's doing well... Every day is fulfilling. And Iroha seems happy too... But...
text_block_list.orig_text:
腰痛ないし
寝起きもスッキリで
子どもの体、
最高
って思ってた。
お店もギルドも順調で、
充実した毎日。
なんだかんだイロハもよろこんでる……
でも。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: But... that's right. While I'm in this body... I can't fall in love.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも……
そうだ。
この体じゃ、
恋愛……
できない。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: In this body, I can't fall in love... or get married. ...Not that I ever cared about that. Dating's a hassle, and I've never been interested in love.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この体じゃ、
恋愛も、
結婚もできない。
……
別にそんなこと
何とも思ったことなかった。
付き合うとか面倒だし、
恋なんてものにも
興味ない。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: At least, that’s what I always thought... ...Hah.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう思ってたはずなのに……
……っ。

text_block_list.name: Waiter
text_block_list.text: We will now commence with the bride's bouquet toss! Food service will be temporarily paused! All guests, please make your way to the front──
text_block_list.orig_text:
これより
花嫁さんによるブーケトスが行われますので
食事の提供は
一時中断いたします！
列席の皆様は
どうぞ
前の方に──

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...! Ah, looks like there's some kind of event starting. Let's talk later...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！
っと、
なんかイベント始まった。
話は
後にしよ……！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Let's see, a bouquet toss... Ah, that one. The thing where if you catch the bride's bouquet, they say you're the next to get married.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えーと、
ブーケトス。
ああ、
あれか。
花嫁が
投げた花束を受け取ると
次
結婚できるとかいうやつ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: I mean, back then I used to dream about it, just like anyone else... Even now, I guess I'd be lying if I said I didn't.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そりゃあ、
昔は
人並みに憧れてたし……
今もまあ、
ないといえば嘘になるかな。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Actually, I'd appreciate it if you didn't bring that up right now. For my mental well-being... Yeah.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……てか、
今
そういうぶっこみ
やめてほしいな。
精神衛生的に……
うん。

text_block_list.name: Bride
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's begin! Our next bridge will be... YOU♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあいきます！
次の花嫁は、
あなたよー♪

text_block_list.name: Bride
text_block_list.text: Ready and...!
text_block_list.orig_text: せーの！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah?! Wha-... What are you doing?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
は？
ちょっ……
何すんの？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The bouquet the bride threw arced gracefully through the air and, with perfect timing, {0} lifted Sono into his arms. The bouquet landed softly in her hands, as if it were meant to be there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
花嫁に投げられたブーケは弧を描き{0}が
抱えあげたソノの腕に、
吸い込まれるように収まる。

text_block_list.name: ソノ
text_block_list.text:
え？　
は？　
どういうこと？
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
は？　
どういうこと？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Wait... What's this? Well, it's a bouquet, obviously, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっ……
なにこれ？
いや、
なにってブーケだけど……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Don't tell me, did you ask me if I had a dream of being a bride... just so you could make me catch the bouquet?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
もしかして　
憧れがあるか聞いたのって……
ブーケ
とらせるため？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: No, more importantly... right now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
それよりも……
ここって。

text_block_list.name: ソノ
text_block_list.text: ……彼の腕の中？
text_block_list.orig_text: ……彼の腕の中？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Hey... what are you doing out here in public? You can't just pick someone up like that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
公衆の面前で何してんのよ？
そんな、
人のこと
軽々しく抱き上げて……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: I mean, he's way too close! Right when I started to become conscious of him... too close!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
てか近いってば！
さっき意識しちゃったばっかだってのに
近すぎるって。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: No, that's not the issue here... Besides, it's no good. If a kid like me catches it, won't that just kill the mood?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
そういう問題じゃなくて……
それに、
ダメでしょ。
こんな子どもがとっちゃったら
場が白けちゃわない？

text_block_list.name: Bride
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, nice catch. You got that for Sono, huh. What a good niece you are!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
ナイスキャッチ。
ソノのためにとってくれたんだ。
いい子だね、
姪っ子ちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Umm, that’s not really it... It just sorta happened... He kinda did it on his own...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと、
そういうわけじゃ……
なりゆき
っていうか、
彼が
勝手に……

text_block_list.name: Bride
text_block_list.text: Or maybe... you did it yourself for him? The one carrying you right now?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それとも……
自分と
抱っこしてくれてる彼のためかな？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: WHA-...? N-No, um... It’s not like we’re... like that... yet...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっ？
いや
あの……
まだ
そういう
関係じゃ
なくて……

text_block_list.name: Bride
text_block_list.text: Hehe... "Not yet", huh? Sorry. You just reminded me of the old Sono, I couldn't help but tease you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ……
まだ、
か。
ごめんね。
昔のソノに似てて
ついからかっちゃった。

text_block_list.name: Bride
text_block_list.text: Can you do me a favor and tell Sono? Tell her I said... I hope she finds happiness too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ソノに伝えてもらっていいかな？
あなたも、
幸せになってね、
って。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Thanks...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん……
ありがと……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: On the way home.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その、
帰り道。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... Seriously. Why did all of that happen...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
まったく。
私ってば
なんであんなことを……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: I got completely swept up in the whole wedding atmosphere. What a terrifyingly happy space...
text_block_list.orig_text:
完全に披露宴の空気に流されちゃってたわね。
おそるべし、
幸せ空間……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Huh? That’s because you suddenly picked me up and spun me around just like that. Of course it got to my head.
text_block_list.orig_text:
は？　
そんなの、
君がいきなり抱えあげて
振り回すようなことしたから
頭に血が上ってんの。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: So with that said... yeah... carry me all the way back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうわけだから、
ん……
おんぶ、
してよ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: I was thinking the same back when he got me enveloped in his arms earlier... He's a lot more built than I thought. Of course that’d make my heart race a little.
text_block_list.orig_text:
抱っこされた時も思ったけど……
思ってたより
がっしりしてんだよね。
そりゃ、
ドキドキもするっての。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: But, for some reason... Right now, I feel... really safe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
なんか、
今は安心できる感じ……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: It's nothing... so you don't have to worry about it. Fwaaah... Yeah... For now... not yet...
text_block_list.orig_text:
別に、
なんでもないから
気にしなくていいよ。
ふぁあ……
うん……
今は
まだ、
ね……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: As she said that, Sono drifted off to sleep on {0}'s back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう言いながら、
ソノは{0}の
背中でまどろむのだった。
